overview: Follows Tomás de Noronha, a History professor and a cryptoanalysis and ancient languages expert, who is hired to decipher an enigmatic message, but ends up on the trail of the true identity and mission of Christopher Columbus.
title: Codex 632

overview: Take a soaring tour of America from above.
title: Aerial Adventures

overview: 'Fright Night: America's Scariest Hotels' explores the most haunted hotels across the country, investigating the dark truth behind these dark places. Will host Abby Hornacek survive the overnight?
title: Fright Night: America's Scariest Hotels

overview: Abandoned for decades, America's most notorious asylum is being renovated. The new owners are plagued by troubled souls. A paranormal investigator and psychic medium unlock Eloise Asylum's history.
title: Secrets of the Asylum

overview: Thrust into a mystic realm amid a kingdom's civil war, modern girl Xi Yuan awakens her hidden phoenix power. Risking everything, she defies the highest divine law and uses her wits and courage to save the entire realm.
title: The Great Queen

overview: Zhao Tan Tan's senior brother has a magic flower on his forehead, and it will gradually bloom if he is emotional. The magic flower will fall into the devil's hand when it blooms. From then on, Zhao Tan Tan began the hard days of persuading his senior brother to recite more scriptures and be less emotional.
title: Blooming

overview: In each episode of Pawnography, contestants will compete against each other and 'The Pawn Stars' in three rounds of trivia style questions - that escalate in difficulty as the rounds advance - to win money and coveted items from the World Famous Gold & Silver Pawnshop. Rick, Corey & Chumlee are featured in each episode as they vigorously defend their treasured items from confident and brainy contestants. The cherished items up for grabs are from Rick's personal collection and he doesn't want to give them up - this is the only game show that doesn't want the contestants to win!
title: Pawnography

overview: After star Louise Lasser left Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman, it was rebranded Forever Fernwood and continued to follow the trials and tribulations of May's family and friends.
title: Forever Fernwood

overview: Steve Rider presents the series of interviews with Formula One legends of the past and present.
title: The Legends of F1

overview: During the Northern Song Dynasty, a bustling corner of Qu'er Alley in Bianliang City was home to the Zhao family, five individuals with wildly different personalities. Zhao Buyou, a low-ranking clerk, sought a simple life, while his wife, Wen Yue, aimed to buy land and secure their future. Despite frequent arguments, the family remained close. Their lives took a dramatic turn when they were drawn into the sensational Mei Ship case. Solving mysteries became a journey of tackling family struggles and growing together. Case by case, they exposed the so-called "Good Man of Jiangnan" as a fraud, broke a market monopoly, and uncovered political corruption. In the end, they safeguarded their family's happiness and brought peace to Bianliang.
title: Riverside Code at Qingming Festival

overview: A collapsed woman, wearing white clothes, is found at a park in the early morning hours. The woman introduces herself as Byakuya. Except for her name, she doesn't remember anything else about herself. She doesn't know general stuff either, but she holds extensive medical knowledge and has a genius-like diagnostic ability. With just the smallest amount of information, she is able to diagnose any disease. She begins to work with a diagnosis team at a hospital.
title: Dr. White

overview: Based on the hit novel by Wang Yu, this fantasy epic follows an ordinary village boy. By a twist of fate, he enters a world of cultivation. With brains, grit, and relentless drive, he battles his way to the top among immortals.
title: The Immortal Ascension

overview: Stephen Fry hosts a new version of the legendary quiz show Jeopardy! Featuring Australian contestants for the first time, players guess the questions to the answers given. Testing their buzzer skills and their knowledge in a range of academic and popular categories, the winner gets to claim the title and keep the prize money.
title: Jeopardy! Australia

overview: The television series centers on the life of Salahudddin, a 12th-century Muslim ruler, and his conquest of Jerusalem. It also delves into his challenges and conflicts against the Crusaders, as well as his ambition to unify the Muslim territories of Syria, northern Mesopotamia, Palestine, and Egypt under his leadership.
title: Kudüs Fatihi Selahaddin Eyyubi

overview: Together with her mother Franka, Lisa moves to the remote town of Großstetten in the Black Forest. Above all, Franka, the town's new police chief, hopes the move will be a fresh start for her daughter. At her old school, the 17-year-old was bullied because of her panic attacks. Whilst Lisa cautiously gets in touch with her new classmates, she witnesses a gruesome suicide at the memorial service for the victims of a rampage at her school. Simon, another student at Großstetten, is confronted by his parents: They have found out that he is gay. Simon's father Karl, pastor of a strict free church community, convinces his son to undergo conversion therapy. While Franka's investigation brings to light some unresolved questions about the suicide, the realm of the dead seems to reach out to Lisa. With her super-sensory gift, Lisa gets closer and closer to the mystery of the creepy apparitions.
title: Was wir fürchten

overview: Illegal smuggling, armed robbery, large scale prostitution and malicious murders are among the 16 unique stories in this true crime series.
title: True Nordic Crimes

overview: Takashiro Naoya is a handsome salaryman who works for a top company. However, he is also a notorious playboy with a bad taste in women. By chance, he ends up becoming the live-in muse for Fukunaga Akane, an erotic fiction writer who has little experience in love.
title: Kaettekitara Ippai Shite.

overview: Tang Lici, a man whose sense of justice and evil is hard to define, is betrayed by a former friend and forced into the Fengliu Parlor's conspiracy to overthrow the martial world. With a cold, commanding gaze upon all under heaven, he uses the foreign martial art "Rebirth Codex" to secretly investigate the Thirteen Towers, outwit the Jianwang City, form an alliance with the Biluo Palace, and ultimately take charge of the Sword Society of the Central Plains to confront the Fengliu Parlor. Along the way, he forges deep bonds with Chi Yun, Shen Langhun, and others, and is moved by the chivalrous heroes' willingness to risk their lives for the sake of the common people. In the end, Tang Lici chooses to shoulder the mission of protecting the future of the martial world.
title: Whispers of Fate

overview: Esther was trained by her father, but believes that certain things at De Poli need to be changed. That is why she is trying to set up her own Sexology department. To her great frustration, her father finds her vision 'nonsense' and only causes delays without generating any money.
title: De Poli

overview: Baili Dong Jun, the youngest son of the Hou Mansion in Zhenxi, was stubborn since he was a child. He was not good at poems and books, he also did not like to read the art of war or martial arts, but one thing that he was good at was making wine, because he had an agreement with Ye Yun, a friend who was murdered when he was young, to become a "wine fairy". However, his destiny could not be left to his choice. In the end, he went to the school of Li Changsheng, the number one in the world, and began to learn martial arts. And in the process, he got acquainted with Yue Yao, and reunited with Ye Yun, who had now been renamed as Ye Dingzhi. Under their influence and encouragement, Baili Dong Jun began to re-examine his identity and responsibilities. Many years later, Ye Dingzhi was used by others to launch a war against the Central Plains. And Baili Dong Jun led a group of heroes to resist. Facing the best friend, Baili Dongjun did not back down at this time. He wanted to save the common people as well as his own friend!
title: Dashing Youth

overview: Xiao Wuxia, the young lord of Yueluo City, has been living in hiding in Liang Kingdom under the alias Wei Zhao, bearing the shame of being labeled a traitor. His mission is to uncover the truth behind his family's downfall and capture the sole survivor of Prince Qi's case. However, his plans are derailed by the unexpected arrival of Jiang Ci. Pei Yan takes the injured Jiang Ci into his home, aiming to discover who's behind the disruption. As they spend time together, Jiang Ci's innocence and Wei Zhao's tragic past and sense of national duty spark mutual affection. In the end, Wei Zhao, Jiang Ci, and Pei Yan set aside their personal grievances to unite against the Liang Emperor, achieving their goal of protecting Yueluo City and establishing a just world.
title: Love of Nirvana
De Slimste Mens: The Morning After

overview: A drama about what happens when a dangerous handmade cookie that fulfills a dream devours an elite high school.
title: High Cookie

overview: Niels Oxen is Denmark's most decorated hunting soldier. During battle in Mali, he loses his best friend because his superior, Major Hannibal Frederiksen, lets them down. Oxen succeeds in persuading the chairman of the defense committee, Johnny Gregersen, to set up a commission of inquiry to uncover the process. At the same time, the head of PET, Frigg Mossman, is conducting an unofficial investigation into a secret power network in Denmark.
title: Oxen

overview: Things get steamy when Jessica Ross, Rekha Shankar, and their hilarious guests review the finest erotic literature the internet has to offer.
title: Erotic Book Club

overview: Adam Richman crisscrosses the country on the ultimate quest to uncover unique, surprising and delicious hidden food treasures. Having spent years on the road introducing viewers to America's most interesting eating establishments, Richman has tasted nearly every dish imaginable, and learned of many cuisine secrets lurking around the American food scene. The foodie and in-the-know host unveils a combination of off-the-menu items and off-the-grid restaurants – some that are even hidden to locals! For Season 2, the show's name was changed to Secret Eats with Adam Richman.
title: Secret Eats with Adam Richman

overview: Liu Yan, a "genius teenage boxer", sees her hard-earned career go up in smoke for refusing to throw a match. To make matters worse, she receives news of the death of her mother, who abandoned her years ago. Traveling abroad to handle her mother's affairs, Liu Yan is left with massive debts and custody of her younger brother. With her mother's fate uncertain, Liu Yan decides to stay and search for her. In this foreign land, she meets new friends: her landlord and confidante Tang Shuangshuang, legal counsellor Lu Tianchi, her half-brother Li Zan, and He Guangyuan, heir to Gaodi Restaurant. Starting out as a kitchen hand, Liu Yan works her way up to become a rising star in the restaurant industry. Just as she begins to find her footing, her mother's unexpected return throws her life into turmoil once again... Through all the ups and downs in a foreign country, Liu Yan ultimately takes control of her own destiny and forges a path to survival on her own terms.
title: HER

overview: Taichu, ancient sacred tree of Xuefeng mountain, and Xinyue, the saint of Snowluo tribe, help Donglin Wang Guangye in competitions. Disputes between countries, including King Beirong, Princess Regent of Nanchu, and others. Who will dominate the Central Plains? Masters like Shangguan Zui, Meng Yilang and Yanshi Meng Ji enter the scene with cunning strategies and chess figures. What will this bring to Bo Yun's chaotic world?
title: Sacred Tree Has Heart

overview: A struggling journalist teams up with a dimension-traveling wizard who is stuck in our world without his magic powers. She helps him on his quest to return home in exchange for the rights to his story. When a rift between the realms opens up and fantastical foes invade, they are forced to solve the mystery of what binds their worlds, and their fates, together.
title: Riftworld Chronicles

overview: Rachael Ray knows firsthand that when disaster strikes your home, rebuilding your life is the toughest task of all. Rachael and her team are now using their experience and resources to help families rebuild their homes and their lives, better than before.
title: Rachael Ray's Rebuild

overview: The exceptionally gifted Ghost King, He Simu, unexpectedly encounters the young general, Duan Xu, while out on a break, searching for food. This young general, who carries an item belonging to someone from He Simu's past, seems not to be the real Duan Xu. As they test each other through subtle exchanges, He Simu gradually uncovers the dark past and aspirations hidden within Duan Xu's heart. In turn, Duan Xu discovers the steadfastness and loneliness that He Simu has endured. Despite the fleeting lifespan of a mortal, no more than a hundred years, and the four-hundred-year-old ghost who still retains the appearance of a young girl, they resist the relentless passage of time through their love.
title: Love Beyond the Grave

overview: Modern-day office drone Zou Yan accidentally stumbles into the world of cultivation and wakes up as Liao Tingyan, a disciple of the Qinggutian Sect. She's soon selected to serve the reclusive Grandmaster Sima Jiao, a powerful cultivator who's been secretly sealed inside a mountain for 500 years. Twisted by isolation and rage, he's cold, hot-tempered, and bent on revenge. Liao Tingyan doesn't konw that "her" original identity is a demonic assassin. But to his surprise, she shows no ill will, no ambition, and no desire at all. Her nature fascinates him. Thus begins an unlikely romance between a villainous immortal and a healing-type "slacker," a connection that defies fate and spans lifetimes.
title: When Destiny Brings The Demon

overview: Assisted by a nice group of well-known Flemish people, Pieterjan and Jeff discuss every week what is going on behind the scenes of the Flemish media landscape.
title: Achter De Schermen

overview: A loving couple's quiet life in a small Southwestern town ends abruptly and violently in the middle of the night; gunshots and chaos give way to unbearable shock and grief as investigators hunt down three ruthless killers.
title: Murder at the Cabin

overview: In order to win the jackpot of €100.000, the participants will need to work as allies to achieve the price money. But after a month, will one of the participant decide to destroy their alliance and go home with the entire jackpot for himself? A fascinating battle full of strategy, teamwork and manipulation follows.
title: De Bondgenoten

overview: In this new crime program, Marcel van de Ven and his team of crime specialists stand up for people who have fallen victim to scammers, extortionists, online abusers and/or other criminals on the internet - or social media.
title: Online Criminelen Ontmaskerd

overview: Battleground is a workplace dramedy set in the world of political campaigns. Head campaign strategist Chris "Tak" Davis and his staff strive to win a Senate seat for their underdog candidate in a race with national consequences. It takes place in Wisconsin, a real battleground state, where Tak and his team manipulate the 24-hour news cycle, new media, and social networking to navigate the unpredictable ups and downs of state politics. All the while, a documentary crew exposes the behind-the-scenes chaos of idealistic twenty-somethings trying to make a difference.
title: Battleground

overview: In the HGTV series Buying Back the Block. Mike and his wife, television producer and design enthusiast Kyra Epps, who've already transformed an abandoned firehouse on the block into their stunning new family home, will continue improving the neighborhood and restoring a sense of community with more property renovations. In the two one-hour episodes, the duo will update each house, adding modern amenities and keeping the original charm, to create affordable and beautiful places for families to buy or rent. Driven by his passionate vision, Mike will be hands-on as he oversees the projects, including the overhaul of his grandmother's house, alongside his expert construction team.
title: Buying Back the Block

overview: The actors of the show "Ural Dumplings" will remember their technical education to recreate fairy tale scenes.
title: Уральские умельцы

overview: A new Australian version of Top Gear, the globally acclaimed series known for its adrenaline-fuelled adventures and outrageous challenges, is parking itself on Paramount+ Australia in 2024. The series will be produced by BBC Studios local production arm. It wouldn't be Top Gear without the high-octane antics, so rest assured, they aren't going anywhere. But in 2024, the mechanics behind Top Gear Australia have given the series an epic tune up, introducing three new hosts. In the driver's seat is music composer and car enthusiast, Blair Joscelyne, loveable larrikin Beau Ryan and Jonathan LaPaglia.
title: Top Gear Australia

overview: Deal or No Deal, the exhilarating hit game show where contestants must beat the Banker to win a huge cash prize of $100,000, is making a triumphant return to 10 and 10 Play. Hosted by TV Week Gold Logie award winner Grant Denyer, every episode is a high-pressure, high-stakes game of risk versus reward in which contestants face a series of potentially life-altering decisions.
title: Deal or No Deal

overview: Wheel of Fortune Australia hosted by the charismatic, Graham Norton, will bring the classic game show back to primetime. The epic game show will once again be centered around a giant carnival wheel as contestants spin to win for a life changing cash prize.
title: Wheel of Fortune Australia

overview: A brand-new incarnation of the much-loved cooking show Ready Steady Cook is primed to hook Friday night audiences. The host? None other than the Prince of Paella… the God of Gazpacho… the incredible Miguel Maestre.
title: Ready Steady Cook

overview: In this series, we meet some of the UK's most unequal households, in which one partner – usually the woman – is taking on more of the domestic load than anyone else in the home. In each episode, two participants (not always women) from two different households down tools and walk out on their ungrateful families. Those left behind must try and muscle through one week without the family linchpin, as we uncover the real dynamics of the household. As their strike unfolds, we follow both sides as they try to cope in this unique look at how we all live together in modern Britain.
title: Wife on Strike

overview: The true story of how the NSW Police Taskforce Air, and in particular Detective Paul Gordon, tracked down and caught Ivan Milat – the man responsible for the infamous Backpacker Murders in Australia's Belanglo State Forest from 1990 onwards. Set against a backdrop of a public alarm, high level government pressure and an international press demanding a result, Catching Milat is a pacy, psychological thriller.
title: Catching Milat

overview: For over four decades Die Hard and Indiana Jones have captivated audiences with jaw-dropping action sequences and thrilling adventures, but could you survive some of the infamous stunts in these films? The Unofficial Science of… returns to Sky Max with two new specials: The Unofficial Science of Die Hard and The Unofficial Science of Indiana Jones.
title: The Unofficial Science of...

overview: After months of sweat, tears, and lash glue, Trixie Motel has officially been open for almost a year and Trixie Mattel and her partner David look to do something some might say is even scarier: moving in together and designing a dream home fit for two.
title: Trixie Motel: Drag Me Home

overview: Brave Aline sets off on a journey to defend her legacy and build a better future for herself and her family. After her husband's murder during an attempted invasion of the land where they live, the teacher becomes an agricultural producer, without ever having planted a seed, facing everything and everyone to make her new dream come true.
title: Terra e Paixão

overview: Biel is one of the residents who has been working in a public hospital for several months. Hundreds of shifts, thousands of hours, which barely leave him time for his life. But it is his vocation and he is willing to do whatever it takes to become the best doctor. What he does not imagine is that a total strike will break out in the hospital, with no minimum services. The doctors are forced to do this to try to raise public awareness of their essential work and to protest against all the intolerable cuts that the public health system is suffering. But Biel and the other residents do not know whether to go along with this strike that could have fatal consequences for patients. And from this conflict we will get to know each of them in their day to day life: who are these young people who go out of their way in the hospital, assuming excessive responsibility, and who are these adults willing to lose everything in order to fight for what they believe in?
title: Respira

overview: Kitada Gaku is gifted in mathematics. He dreamed of becoming a mathematician, but he gave up on his dream. He now spends his days without purpose. One day, he happens to meet a genius chef named Asakura Kai. Asakura Kai leads Kitada Gaku into the culinary world. Kitada Gaku soon joins Asakura Kai's two star restaurant K, where talented chefs from all around the world work together and learn together. There, Kitada Gaku also learns about cooking and develops his own recipes derived from mathematical thought. (Source: AsianWiki)
title: Fermat no Ryori

overview: Anderson Spider Silva is a fictional biographical series about the life of the MMA fighter.
title: Anderson Spider Silva

overview: After receiving a mysterious message, David Rousseau, author of thrillers lacking inspiration, goes to Mouthe, the coldest village in France. The same day, a murder occurs... Seeing the unexpected opportunity of a new novel, Rousseau begins an investigation which encroaches on that of Warrant Officer Louvetot. Trouble definitely sets in when the murders add up... There is a serial killer... in Mouthe!
title: Polar Park

overview: America 2Night is actually the second season of Fernwood 2Night. Host Barth Gimble and his co-host Jerry Hubbard have moved to the fictional "Tri-City" area of Alta Coma, El Tijo, and the City of Merchandise in California. The music is provided by Happy Kyne and the Mirth-Makers.
title: America 2Night
ISHIKO and HANEO: You're Suing Me?

overview: The life of a saleswoman at a second-hand bookstore, Elizaveta, changes dramatically after she gets into a small accident. Her bicycle is knocked down by the famous violinist Karina Ratynskaya. The acquaintance, which began so unpleasantly, continues in the luxurious Ratynskaya mansion. And in the morning the violinist is found murdered. Elizaveta remembers a mysterious man who came to Karina at night. She was able to see only a fragment of a tattoo on his back, similar to the tail of a salamander.
title: Тень саламандры

overview: How did a conflict between the world's wealthiest woman and her daughter spiral into national scandal? This riveting docuseries tells the whole story.
title: L'Affaire Bettencourt : Scandale chez la femme la plus riche du monde

overview: The lobby manager, Tu Xiao Ning, who works on the first floor of Huayuan Tower, is in a crucial period of probation. Ji Yu Heng, a talented young man working on the seventeenth floor of the tower, is a rising star in the business. They share a common desire to get married as soon as possible, and this is where two parallel lines intersect. In Xiao Ning's eyes, Yu Heng exceeds expectations as a marriage partner. In Yu Heng's eyes, the youthful Xiao Ning once illuminated his life, and marrying her is his only firm choice. Just as the two muster the courage to establish their marital relationship, Yu Heng unexpectedly becomes Xiao Ning's superior. These childhood friends from ten years ago, through a twist of fate, find themselves in a dual relationship as colleagues and newlyweds. They work together to explore the meaning of marriage and life. (Source: Chinese = Douban || Translation = MyDramaList) Adapted from the novel "Ban Gong Shi Yin Hun" (办公室隐婚) by Qing An (轻黯)
title: You Are My Secret

overview: May, New Year, birthdays — the Pyzhov family celebrates everything together. The daughters have already matured and bring their grooms to the house, who are trying their best to please the head of the family. He, in turn, believes that no man in the world is worthy of his daughters, and is constantly looking for flaws in guys. Everyone has their own character and beliefs, but the mother finds an excuse to gather everyone at the table to discuss news and problems. Every meeting is just a holiday, but the main thing is to survive it and not quarrel until the next one!
title: Праздники

overview: "The Circuit" is an Australian television drama series. The series stars Aaron Pedersen and Gary Sweet, and centres around indigenous Australian lawyer Drew Ellis who joins the district to work at the Kimberley Circuit Court.
title: The Circuit

overview: This new entry in the Mountain Men franchise follows Alaska legend Marty Meierotto, who chased his dream to live in Alaska in the 1980s and never looked back. He is joined by several other remarkable mountain men and women throughout Alaska, who provide viewers with a glimpse into what it's like to live isolated in the wild.
title: Mountain Men: Alaska

overview: Alexander Volkov, a special forces soldier who has seen the horrors of war, decides to leave military service for the sake of his beloved wife Alyona and service to God. After graduating from the seminary, Volkov is ordained a priest. But the new bright path is overshadowed by the tragic death of Alyona, after which only the Orthodox faith helps Volkov to live. Having received a church parish in his hometown of Starobilsk, Father Alexander becomes a reliable support for parishioners not only from a spiritual point of view. A keen sense of justice and excellent military training do not allow the former special forces soldier to stay away when all sorts of outrages occur around.
title: Настоящий

overview: TNT TV channel is reviving a musical show that became iconic in the 2000s and gave Russian show business more than a dozen stars. The large-scale project will be aired again in an updated format called The New Star Factory. The project is being produced by White Media, which is already producing the TNT shows "Candy" and "Brighter than the Stars". The whole country knows the participants of the project today. Polina Gagarina, Timati, Yulia Savicheva, Vlad Sokolovsky, Natalia Podolskaya, Miguel, Julianna Karaulova, Irina Dubtsova are an incomplete list of those who started their careers in the show. It's time to light up new stars and discover new talents – TNT will do this.
title: Новая фабрика звёзд

overview: In 1943, a shocking explosion in Shanghai results in a confrontation between Communist Party undercover Lu Zhengyang and former police officer Lin Shaobai, each flaunting their skills. Six years later, Shanghai is liberated, and Lu Zhengyang becomes a core member in the anti-espionage efforts of the Shanghai Public Security Bureau. Faced with severe retaliation in their anti-espionage efforts, with the support of his superior and strict screening, Lu Zhengyang boldly employs the former police officer Lin Shaobai, the "Shanghai Expert". The two team up and successively solve major cases such as the "Treasury Robbery", "Counterfeit Coin", and "Hidden Radio" planned by the veteran spy Zheng Lanting of the Shanghai Secret Services' Special Station, completely thwarting the conspiracy of the hidden enemy agents. Working on cases together, Lu Zhengyang and Lin Shaobai go from constant friction to gradually building trust, and eventually becoming comrades who live and die together.
title: Dark Night and Dawn

overview: The story focuses on a special unit of Czech intelligence, known as the Extraktoři (Extractors). The unit operates in secret and its main mission is to ensure the safe return of endangered Czechs from abroad. Extraktoři offers insight into the world of espionage and international covert operations. It provides a behind-the-scenes look at negotiations with terrorists, a topic that is often kept quiet by the world's governments, although they participate unofficially. Extraktoři are concerned with ensuring the safety of Czech citizens across borders, even at the cost of complex negotiations and solutions outside of traditional diplomatic channels.
title: Extraktoři

overview: Three girls and the three dates they will give to a potential suitor. But only one of them will be honored with the title of "goddess of dates". The dates will be evaluated by star experts: Ida Galich, Roman Kagramanov and Daniil Grachev.
title: Богиня свиданий

overview: When CHU Yi-ping, an emotionless man, dislocates his hand in an accident at school, his uncle gives him Ever 9 as a caretaker, an experimental intelligent robot that his company is secretly testing. Although Yi-ping is reluctant at the beginning, he finds that Ever 9 complements his deficiencies and makes him feel the companionship.Yi-ping asks Ever 9 to make a wish and complete the wish list together, but before the list completed, Ever 9 breaks down. The repair only takes a week, Ever 9 is about to be reset. After the reset, Ever 9 rushes to complete the wish list and posing as if he is bored with Yi-ping and actively asking for a return. Yi-ping doesn't know what's wrong with Ever 9, because he has learned from it how to be human and experience love. Can't he learn how to be together for life? Is the promise of not leaving each other null and void?
title: Anti Reset

overview: The untamed wildernesses of Africa encompass the extremes of our planet. Her primordial rhythm continues to beat across seasonal Grasslands, inhospitable Deserts, hazardous Coastlines and competitive Coral Reefs as it has for millennia. The plants and animals in each of these extraordinary landscapes have adapted to the unique demands of their region, rising to meet their daily challenges in astonishing ways. Africa's Deadly Kingdom delves deep into the complex lives of the continent's most remarkable species and their never-ending struggles to survive.
title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom

overview: A satirical thriller about an American woman who suspects her beloved son might have murdered a wealthy pupil at his West London private school.
title: All the Other Mothers Hate Me

overview: Emmanuel Lewis stars as the innocent and adorable Webster Long. When newlyweds George Papadapolis (Alex Karras) and Katherine Calder-Young Papadapolis (Susan Clark) return home from their whirlwind wedding, they discover they are the legal guardians of seven-year-old Webster, the only child of the recently deceased best friend of George. George, a retired football player now sports caster, and Katherine, a socialite and philanthropist, are the perfectly hilarious odd parents learning how to raise a child, often with the help of Katherines highbrow secretary, Jerry (Henry Polic II). Both a touching portrait of an unconventional family and a joyful ride through childhood adventures, Webster is a classic of 80s television.
title: Webster

overview: This story is the difficult journey of Inci and Uygar who forbid love to themselves for different reasons. As human beings run away from their greatest need, they become coldhearted, cruel, and even distant from themselves.
title: Aşka Düşman

overview: As part of the new show, pairs of participants embark on a Great Chinese Adventure. During the month, they will have to travel around the region and complete various tasks at speed, which they will receive in each episode of the show. The winner will be the one who comes to the final point first. Participants will be tested for time, intelligence and endurance. However, the main condition is to show maximum human qualities in the pursuit of Treasure, making the right choice and making the right decisions. 13 couples will participate in the project. In each episode, one will leave the show.
title: Сокровища императора

overview: The series is based on real events of the winter of 1941. Food supplies have dried up and supplies have been blocked. The besieged city was dying of hunger: employees, dependents and children were given 125 grams of bread per day. It was then that a gang appeared in Leningrad, engaged in fraud and robbery. The criminals were mainly involved in counterfeiting food cards.
title: Банда ЗИГ ЗАГ

overview: In the first month, old Master Wuji held a marriage festival, and Tang Xiaolu, the daughter of Buzhuang, accidentally broke into it. One of the two couldn't help it, and the other made a mistake. Wuji took off Tang Xiaolu's mask and asked them to get engaged. The newlyweds had their own thoughts. Wuji turned out to be an Ouchi spy, but Tang Xiaolu was exactly the same as his deceased fiancée!
title: The Killing Romance

overview: The series is adapted from the novel of the same name by Cang Yue. The story follows the unrestrained swordsman Huo Zhanba, who seeks medicine for a friend's child and encounters the pharmacist Xue Ziyue. Over eight years of daily interaction, they progress from having their own convictions to deepening understanding, mutual redemption, and a promise to meet under a plum tree the following year. However, due to the responsibilities they bear, they find it difficult to express their love, leaving behind a regret of eternal separation. Amidst the joyous toasts in the snowy night and a farewell across a thousand miles, a poignant and unforgettable missed opportunity unfolds—a love destined to be unable to endure, depicting a tale of redemption and letting go in a life-and-death romance.
title: Snowy Night: Timeless Love
